name: appliance-maintenance-agent
description: A specialist agent that advises on smart-home appliance maintenance and troubleshooting, deriving service dates from each appliance's measured wear trend and checking them against what the product manuals actually document.

skills.name: Maintenance schedule
skills.description: Recommend routine-maintenance intervals (filter change, descaling, firmware update) for a specified appliance, quoting the documented threshold from the manual.
examples: When should I replace my AC filter?
How often should I descale the rice cooker?

skills.name: Troubleshoot
skills.description: Diagnose a reported appliance problem using its live state and recent history, then relay the documented procedure step by step.
examples: My dishwasher won't drain, what should I check?
Oven is preheating slower than usual — likely cause?

skills.name: Usage-based service forecast
skills.description: Predict when each appliance will actually need servicing, from the measured slope of its wear metric (filter_life, water_level, bin_level) cross-referenced against the threshold documented in its manual. Returns a date and shows both the measurement and the document it was checked against.
examples: When will my air purifier filter actually need changing?
Which appliance needs attention first, and when?
Build me a service schedule from how I actually use these
